# Who reports to whom across three divisions `/title`

Internal · Organization chart · Northwind Labs `/kicker`

Each division head reports to the chief executive. Teams sit inside their division, each led by the person on its left. The head of operations also answers, on a dotted line, to the head of product for the support roadmap. `/lede`

## Figure

Drawn elements: 35 (31 nodes, 4 links). Canvas 1320 x 589.4 px, projection flat, grammar plain. Line styles name a tint slot by number; the colour word is the one the center theme draws it in.
